questions.text:
1.—Do you have any plans for the weekend, Linda?()
—Sure. I ____ games with my friends.
A. am going to play B. am playing C. play

2. Look! Alice ____ a model plane over there.()
A. makes B. is making C. will make

3. He ____ to invent a flying car.()
A. is B. is going C. will

4.—They are going to ____ a picture book.()
—I think it'll be interesting.
A. read B. read C. reading

5. Tom is going to ____ TV ____ Sunday.()
A. watching; in B. watch; on C. watch; at

6. What is Alice ____ after lunch?()
A. doing B. going C. going to do

7. Simon looks busy. What is he going to do?()
A. He is doing his homework.
B. He is going to skate.
C. He often does his homework.

8. Linda usually ____ her clothes in the morning, but now she ____ her hair.()
A. washes; is washing B. is washing; washes C. wash; is washing

9. Linda ____ like reading books. But she will ____ more books in the future.()
A. doesn't; read B. don't; reading C. doesn't; to read

10. Lucy ____ to school on foot.()
A. go B. goes C. going

11. Ben ____ the mountain at the weekend.()
A. climb B. will climbs C. is going to climb

12. The flowers like ____ and they are ____ in the wind softly.()
A. dance; dancing B. dancing; dancing C. dancing; dance

13. Jill. ____ wear glasses in the future.()
A. won't B. doesn't C. isn't

14. We will go to Beijing ____ week.()
A. last B. after C. next

15. I won't give you any ice creams ____ you get well.()
A. until B. but C. to
16. Miss Spring never ____ (come) late again.
17. My sister sometimes ____ (watch) TV in the evening.
18. He is ____ (knock) down the house because he plans to build a new one.
19. There ____ (be) many great ____ (invent) in the world.

20.—I have a ____ (head) now.
—Have a good rest and you ____ (get) well soon.
